title: Road closure practice
body: Lesson dates stop at the county road closure; the house key is tied to the page beside a note to keep the fee for the missed lessons. No return date is written.
rival_reading: A field crew could have closed the road for work nearby and left the key with a lesson note; nothing here says what forced the closure.
gloss: A lesson page and key preserve the dates and household cost of a road closure.

title: Closed windows
body: Please keep the lesson room shut until the roadside spray test is over. The children can still hear the truck from the front room; their mother has paid for the whole week already.
rival_reading: A response crew could have tested roadside treatment after a closure; closed lessons and a prepaid week do not show what the spray was meant to control.
gloss: A lesson moves indoors while a roadside field test continues.
